sources.author: Forum user; no Apple response
sources.finding: Reports a Metal validation crash during navigation between RealityViews when attached to Xcode. This differs from our non-crashing stale colors without debugger and supplies no tested remedy.

sources.author: Apple engineer Michael
sources.finding: Explains dependency-driven SwiftUI reevaluation, lightweight State initialization, and RealityView state synchronization. Recommends avoiding state mutation from the update closure and discusses onChange as an alternative. This is general API guidance, not a diagnosis of the observed stale frames.

decision: No production fix or framework root-cause claim follows. Prior external-only sync attempt already failed; do not repeat solely because general guidance mentions it. Continue controlled runtime boundary.
